Just read your piece What Is Demand Generation? Complete B2B Guide. Quick heads up: under "What is B2B demand generation?" an editing note went live as body text, starting "This keeps the bold definition, keeps the useful bullet list".

I run a motion studio. Happy to swap founder quotes: one from me on explainer videos for "3. Create content that answers real buyer questions", and one from you for ours.

In return, a credit link back to motiontheagency.com with my quote, and one to yours with your quote on ours, or we'll pay for placement instead.

Would you be open to exploring this?

Cheers,
Sam
